text:
maria: Heads-up — while running the quant2b int4 bring-up sweep, we observed a cluster of semantic drift on the PromptSet-Bridge samples (esp. customer-intent & multi-step instructions).
jonathan: Ugh. Can you paste an example? :eyes:
maria: Sure — example where baseline & q8b agree, quant2b-int4 turns 'schedule meeting' into 'summarize meeting'. Small prompt but big outcome.
lee: That smells like attention collapse on short prompts. Did you check kv-cache behavior / prefix truncation?
maria: @lee started with that. KV length looks ok, but logits for instruction tokens drop off ~step 3. I attached the logits diff snippet below.
maria: ```
// logits diff (gold - int4)
token: "schedule"  delta: +0.02
token: "meeting"   delta: +0.18
token: "summarize" delta: -0.21
```
priya: Could be quant rounding bias on embedding matmul. Any overlap with our golden set?
maria: We cross-checked 200 gold anchors; 7 fail cases overlap with anchorbank. Noted two where labels changed from TASK->SUMMARIZE.
jonathan: Do we have fingerprint collisions between promptset-bridge and seedbank? Maybe dedupe caused wrong context to pair.
sam: I re-ran the sample fingerprint check — only 1 near-dup, most are distinct. Sampling distribution skew: the bridge sampler pulled more short-context conversational prompts than we usually test.
priya: OK action items then: (1) triage whether this is quant artifact vs sampling mismatch, (2) hand the 7 anchors to label-ops for quick relabel / consensus, (3) run focused int8 vs int4 diffs on that cohort.
maria: I can prod the model diffs and attach a small eval harness. Draft command: ```bash
python eval_harness.py --model=quant2b-int4 --cohort=bridge_edge --out=diffs/1771234.json
```
lee: Also run with --force-kvcache-check to surface false negatives.
jonathan: @ops-bot can we spin a small dedicated instance with the quant2b-int4 binary and pinned tokens so we can reproduce latency+kv metrics?
ops-bot: deploy request accepted. Instance q2b-int4-debug-1 scheduled on gpu-pool-3, ETA ~12m. :rocket:
priya: @sam can you open a small label-ops ticket with the 7 anchors + sample ids and tag @label-ops? Provide the current label and suggested audit note.
sam: On it. creating ticket now. Will ping when done.
maria: Also adding a quick sampling tweak: increase long-context weight in the bridge sampler by +15% and re-run a small smoke to see change in failure rate.
lee: If this reduces failures it's likely sampling blindspot. If not, it's quant degradation.
jonathan: Timeline: want initial repro + labels by EOD. If quant issue, escalate to research for kernel/quant matrix tweak.
priya: Noted. I'll coordinate with research if labels confirm model-side regression.
sam: Ticket created: LB-4829; attached 7 anchors, model diffs, repro command. Pinged @label-ops and @research.
maria: Great. I'll start the harness runs and post diffs in this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
